bullets.text: In Chennai, a road collapse near a metro site swallowed an SUV into a 10-foot sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road, leaving occupants unharmed.
In Chennai, police detained protesters in Besant Nagar during nationwide demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the electoral rolls revision.
In Thiruvallur, the public detained police officers, causing major disruption and protests that the office should monitor closely.
Minister R. Kumar informed that disaster management preparations to handle the northeast monsoon have been successfully completed in Ponneri.
Minister R. Kumar inaugurated 24 battery-operated garbage collection vehicles worth 48 lakh rupees across 21 village panchayats in Gummidipoondi.
In Chennai, youths demanding the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar were detained at Besant Nagar following SIR voter list protests.
The Chennai Meteorological Department announced that the Northeast Monsoon is likely to begin in Tamil Nadu on October 17, 2026.
Greater Chennai Traffic Police implemented commercial and heavy vehicle diversions across the city due to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit.
Motorists faced severe hardship due to garbage burning along the Ponneri-Minjur highway, highlighting a lack of proper waste management infrastructure.
Water resources personnel intensified desilting and clearing work on the Nandhi River to prevent flood risks ahead of the monsoon.
Journalists raised objections and engaged in a verbal altercation after a collector's personal assistant pushed away a microphone while trying to question Minister Kumar.
Reliance Jio is set to establish a massive 37-megawatt AI data centre and technology campus in Siruseri, creating significant employment opportunities.
Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that a draft consultation paper on AI regulations will be released within 30 days.
The TVK IT wing released an AI-generated video featuring MGR speaking to Chief Minister Vijay, drawing significant public attention.
Farmers issued a deadline until October 22 to the TVK government regarding crop loan waivers, threatening indefinite hunger strikes if demands are unmet.
DMK President M.K. Stalin strongly criticized the TVK government for acting as an extension of the BJP and unleashing police crackdowns on protesting students.
Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin condemned the TVK government for deploying police to suppress peaceful youth protests in Besant Nagar against the CEC.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Chennai to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service.
Chennai's Metropolitan Transport Corporation will enhance feeder bus services along the Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani corridor of Metro Rail Phase II.

stories.title: Chennai Traffic Diversions on October 10 for Rahul Gandhi’s Programme
takeaways: Chennai Traffic Police announced diversions for Rahul Gandhi's event at Island Grounds.
Commuters were advised to plan alternative routes to avoid heavy congestion.
